payload.unit_title: R21 Major Project Master Shell & Modular Blade Partials (M2.2-IMPLEMENT-001)
payload.objective: Request formal TASK_DISPATCH for Slice 1 of M2.2 (Master Shell & Modular Blade Partials Structure).
payload.explicit_request: M2.2 plan is approved and unit state is READY. Please issue the formal TASK_DISPATCH for M2.2-IMPLEMENT-001 (Slice 1: Master Shell & Modular Blade Partials Structure). Every task must consider existing CampusLynk global shells (<x-layouts.workspace-layout>) and components (<x-ui.*>) to avoid duplication. Provide exact instructions, constraints, and allowed_files.

payload.reason: M2.2 is READY and its dependency M2.1 is completed and checkpointed. The approved architectural analysis identified Slice 1 as the correct first implementation boundary: establish the CampusLynk workspace shell and decompose the 2,611-line legacy view into modular Blade partials while preserving the existing functional structure. This task is strictly limited to presentation structure; modal implementation and client-side JavaScript/AJAX behavior remain deferred to M2.2-IMPLEMENT-002. The implementation must reuse the established workspace shell and x-ui.* component library rather than recreate equivalent UI infrastructure.

task_dispatch.objective: Implement the R21 Major Project frontend workspace shell and modular Blade partial structure, replacing the 2,611-line legacy monolithic view with a maintainable CampusLynk workspace composed entirely from the existing layout and UI component system.
instructions: Inspect the approved M2.2-ANALYZE-001 report, the legacy virtual_classroom_project.blade.php, and the existing CampusLynk workspace-layout and x-ui.* component implementations before editing.
Create the root view at resources/views/r21_project/virtual_classroom_project.blade.php using <x-layouts.workspace-layout> with the appropriate title, subjectCode, subjectName, and activeNav props.
Use <x-slot:headerActions> in the workspace shell for the applicable header actions identified during analysis. Use <x-ui.button> for actionable controls and <x-ui.icon> for icons.

Create the approved modular partials: stats-strip.blade.php, tab-register.blade.php, tab-cia.blade.php, tab-ese.blade.php, tab-reports.blade.php, tab-groups.blade.php, tab-attainment.blade.php, and tab-rubrics.blade.php.

Preserve the seven-tab functional structure identified by the architectural analysis and retain the legacy data bindings and display semantics where they are already compatible with the M2.1 backend contract.

Use <x-ui.table> for every data table, <x-ui.card> for statistic/report cards, <x-ui.tabs> for tab navigation, <x-ui.badge> for status/result indicators, <x-ui.button> for actions, <x-ui.input> and <x-ui.select> for form controls, and <x-ui.icon> for SVG/iconography.
Decompose the legacy view rather than copying it. No target Blade file may exceed 500 lines.
Preserve required server-rendered data needed by Slice 2 for subsequent modal and JavaScript wiring. Do not remove backend-facing identifiers or data attributes merely to simplify the markup.

Keep the implementation view-structure focused. Do not implement the six modals, client-side JavaScript routines, AJAX handlers, or new interactive behavior in this slice; those belong to M2.2-IMPLEMENT-002.
Do not introduce custom <style> blocks, duplicate CSS, raw button implementations, raw modal implementations, raw table implementations, or a parallel layout/shell.
Reuse existing CampusLynk design tokens and component APIs instead of recreating legacy visual styling.
Do not modify M2.1 backend files, routes, models, services, migrations, User.php, database state, or migration control-plane state.

After implementation, verify PHP syntax for every modified/created Blade file and run the relevant existing test suite. If a dedicated workspace view test does not yet exist, report that as a verification gap rather than inventing unrelated test infrastructure outside the whitelist.
Verify that every file in the working tree changed by this task belongs to the exact whitelist before reporting completion.
Return a TASK_REPORT only. Do not commit; checkpoint and commit authorization will be handled separately by the architect.
constraints: Allowed target files are exactly the nine files specified by this task; no other application files may be modified.
Do not modify routes, controllers, services, models, migrations, database schema, or control-plane state.
All applicable UI elements MUST reuse existing <x-ui.*> components.
No raw HTML tables where <x-ui.table> applies.
No custom modal implementation; modals are deferred to Slice 2.
No client-side JavaScript or AJAX implementation; deferred to Slice 2.
No custom CSS or duplicate component styling.
No Blade file may exceed 500 lines.
Do not copy the legacy 2,611-line view verbatim or preserve its monolithic structure.
Do not expand scope into M2.3 print-report implementation.
Do not create new global UI components as part of this slice.
task_dispatch.expected_report: Return TASK_REPORT containing: exact files created/modified; final line count of every Blade file; workspace-layout integration details; mapping of implemented sections to x-ui.* components; confirmation that all seven tabs are structurally present; confirmation that modals and JavaScript/AJAX were deferred to Slice 2; PHP/Blade syntax verification; relevant test results; git diff/status and whitelist verification; confirmation that User.php and M2.1 backend/control-plane artifacts were untouched; issues or deviations; and whether the slice is ready for architect checkpoint review.
stop_conditions: Stop if an implementation requires modifying a file outside the nine-file whitelist; report the required file and blocker instead.
Stop if an existing x-ui.* component cannot support a required element and a new global component would be necessary; report the component gap for architect review instead of creating a duplicate.
Do not implement modals or client-side JavaScript/AJAX in this task.
Do not modify database state or execute migrations.
Do not modify migration control-plane state.
